candidates: Proofread prose in source file headers, inline comments, and documentation strings for spelling errors (e.g., in `.jison` file attribution blocks).

When flattening a nested type field across the codebase (e.g., changing `from?: { actor: string }` to `from?: string`), verify the refactor is applied uniformly at every call site. If any consumer still requires double-dereference (e.g., `param.actor.actor`), treat that as a signal that the upstream data producer — such as a jison grammar rule — still emits the old nested shape and must be corrected at that source, rather than patched around in downstream consumers.
